summary: Iteration 5 backend verification complete. Re-ran existing suites (test_unlockvault.py, test_transient_status.py) and added test_health_responsiveness.py proving the event loop stays responsive during heavy work. All 30/30 tests passed. GET /api/health and GET /health (localhost:8001) return 200 {status:ok}. During a 6-file match-passwords run with 80 decoy passwords (CPU-heavy pikepdf scans), 3 concurrent /api/health hammerers logged many successful probes with max latency well under 2s and zero errors - confirming asyncio.to_thread + Semaphore(8) refactor fixed the production event-loop starvation that caused Cloudflare 520. Same held true during the concurrent unlock run. Regressions for upload (encryption detection + sizing), replace, merge-pdf (<2 rejection, ok merge), download (opens without password, Content-Disposition correct), download-zip (valid ZIP, original filenames), invalid session_id (400), transient scanning/unlocking statuses - all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: requests library is used synchronously inside the thread pool for object storage I/O - fine with to_thread but consider httpx.AsyncClient for better throughput at scale.
init_storage() is not thread-safe (global storage_key mutation) - low risk since it only matters on first call and 401 refresh paths.
/health is defined on both root app and api_router - good for liveness probes. Order of @app.get('/health') vs app.include_router(api_router) is fine since paths differ.
SCAN_CONCURRENCY=8 is hardcoded; consider env override for tuning.
seed_data_creation: Tests regenerate /tmp/plain.pdf and /tmp/hv_lk{0..5}.pdf, /tmp/tr_locked_{0..5}.pdf, /tmp/locked_{0..5}.pdf dynamically via pikepdf.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 30 backend tests pass (unlockvault 23, transient_status 2, health_responsiveness 5). Event-loop responsiveness is now verified under heavy load. External URL used: https://mass-file-vault.preview.emergentagent.com. /health non-/api is only reachable on localhost:8001 (ingress routes /api -> backend); the test skips automatically if not reachable but currently passes.
rca of the issue: Previous production 520: single uvicorn worker executed CPU-heavy pikepdf/msoffcrypto operations and synchronous requests calls to object storage directly inside async route handlers, blocking the event loop and starving Kubernetes liveness probe (/health). Fix (verified): all blocking helpers (scan_file_sync, unlock_file_sync, detect_and_store_sync, merge_pdfs_sync, build_zip_sync, get_object for downloads) now run via asyncio.to_thread; a Semaphore(SCAN_CONCURRENCY=8) bounds parallelism; /health and /api/health endpoints added. Health latency under concurrent heavy match/unlock stays <2s with zero errors in testing.
